features:
🐾 Companion Automation
Auto Harvest Coins: Automatically collects coins gathered by your pets.
Smart Deployment: Automatically places/deploys your pets for you.
Auto Nourish: Automatically feeds your pets to keep them energized.
Harvest Now: One-click button to instantly collect all pending coins.
Deploy Strongest: Automatically equips your most powerful pets.
Nourish All: Instantly feeds all currently deployed pets.
View Inventory / View Deployed: Quick access to manage your pets.
📈 Progression & Auto-Farming
Auto Milestone Manager: Automatically manages and claims your game progress milestones.
Smart Ascension: Automatically handles rebirths when you meet the requirements.
Auto Expand Nests: Automatically unlocks new nests to hold more pets.
Auto Claimers:
Claim Index Prizes
Claim Away Income (Offline Earnings)
Claim Group Perks
Claim Event Loot
Auto Activate Radar: Keeps your egg-finding radar active at all times.
Auto Luck Purchasing: Automatically buys luck upgrades with customizable settings:
Purchase Interval: Set how fast it buys upgrades (e.g., every 2 seconds).
Purchase Strategy: Choose between "1 Upgrade" or "Max" per cycle.
Cash Reserve Minimum: Ensures the script stops buying if your cash drops below a certain amount (so you don't go broke).
🛒 Shop & Teleports
Auto Purchase / Auto Replenish: Automatically restocks shop items when available.
Force Replenish: Instantly trigger a shop restock.
Instant Teleports: Instantly teleport to the Food Vendor, Gear Vendor, Merchant, or Radar Station.
👁️ ESP (Wallhacks)
Highlight Eggs: See eggs through walls across the entire map.
Highlight Companions: See pets through walls.
Highlight Players: See other players.
Display Filter: Only show specific rarities (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, Ethereal, Divine, Volcanic).
Show Data Tags: Displays names and distances on the ESP.
Render Distance Limit: Slider to only show ESP within a certain radius to reduce lag.
Teleport to Nearest Target: Instantly teleport to the closest highlighted egg or pet.
